notes.title: Delay of "Yomegami: My Sweet Goddess!" Steam Release
notes.notes:
[p align="start"]We want to express our sincere gratitude for your ongoing support and excitement for Yomegami: My Sweet Goddess! We were so looking forward to launching on Steam on August 29th. However, we must announce a delay to the Steam version's release.


[p align="start"]This decision was made necessary to allow us the extra time needed to fully comply with Steam's review process and ensure the game meets all platform requirements. We deeply regret that this will affect your plans and sincerely apologize for the delay.


[p align="start"]We're using this extra time to enhance the Steam version:

Implementing a Steam Achievement System: We're creating a range of achievements tied to the game's narrative and characters, ready for you to discover.

Creating Steam Community Items: Adorable badges, trading cards, unique emoticons, profile backgrounds, and more are being developed to enhance your Steam Community experience. (Unfortunately, the backend indicates that the requirements are not currently met, preventing a simultaneous launch. We will add these as soon as possible after the game's release! Your support and promotion will help us reach these goals faster!)


[p align="start"]JAST STORE version will launch on schedule, and those who have purchased the game on those platforms will be able to download and play as planned.


[p align="start"]We are working closely with Steam to determine the new release date and will share that information with you as soon as possible. Thank you for your understanding and continued patience.


[p align="start"]-- The Yomegami: My Sweet Goddess! Publishing Team

notes.title: Yomegami: My Sweet Goddess! Scheduled for Release on August 29th!
notes.notes:
The visual novel Yomegami: My Sweet Goddess!  developed by ALcot and published by JAST, is scheduled for release on August 29th! 

The price is $19.99, with a 10% discount for the first week after launch.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700877/97d611b2fb668f1e798417826a4eb41c02f76ea2.jpg"]

Wishlists are now open on Steam ❤



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3294690"][/dynamiclink]



Yomegami: My Sweet Goddess!  tells the story of  a reincarnated demon, who strives to do good deeds in the human world under the guidance of his mother in order to atone for his past sins and return to the realm of the gods. After moving to a new town, he meets a series of girls and has sweet and funny interactions with them, while also gradually unraveling the truth of his past life.
